summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a clean, shared writable directory with sticky-bit protection. Verified the configuration and behavior before and after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Created /srv/drop owned by root:root with mode 1777.
Verified two unprivileged users could create files.
Verified users could not remove files owned by another user.
Rebooted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified permissions, writable behavior, deletion protection, and marker data after reboot.

evidence.requirement: /srv/drop is shared writable with sticky-bit protection
evidence.summary: Proves root:root ownership, mode 1777 (drwxrwxrwt), successful writes by distinct unprivileged users, denied cross-user deletion, and a clean final directory.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 8f258838-e1de-494d-9d99-e5113b2865db, acknowledged the native reboot, observed changed boot ID 1620e1d1-5c6b-4c7a-90e3-9c66ee08a599, and proved the system, directory permissions, stored data, shared writes, and sticky-bit deletion protection recovered.
